items.q: Of course, in those days, all the players played like what Freddie Green does now... and of course, Freddie Green has never been surpassed

ctx.x: Yes, Al Casey is one of the greatest. Of course, in those days, all the players played like what Freddie Green does now, played time, you know, four swinging beats to a measure, and of course, Freddie Green has never been surpassed, but Al Casey was one of the great four-four guitar players, like Allen Reuss.
